Gifted: Suppression.description:
🧬 Suppression, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you stop one person's Quirk in clear sight within about twenty meters while you stare unblinking, and read a Quirk's tell to cut it off before it fires.
📈 With training: flyers downed safely, crowds swept for hidden users, runaway Quirks shut off, a prisoner held all scene, sealed doorways, all Quirks in sight stilled.
⚠️ It stops powers, not people: you still capture by hand. Mutant features never switch off.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as your eyes dry, burn and blur.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eraser Head (Erasure).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Suppression.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Suppression family): Scale: the user's look stops a person's Quirk: at first one person at a time, in clear sight within about twenty meters, about ten seconds without blinking; drying eyes shorten later looks until rested. Under it Emitter Quirks fail and transformations end; what the Quirk already made stays. More needs learned techniques. Limits: Mutant features never switch off, only what a Mutant body sends out. Screens do not carry the look; a blink, smoke, a flash or a blow to the user breaks it and the Quirk returns at once. A stopped foe keeps fists and weapons. Quirk Strain: light: single look, read tell; moderate: grounding a mover, crowd sweep, stopping a runaway Quirk; heavy: scene-long hold, watched doorway; severe: signature stare, a group held all scene. Type: Emitter. Law: switching off a Quirk without a license is unlawful Quirk use; police and agencies prize licensed users for arrests.
